# BCGov Crow - v0.17.3

## Release type

Patch

## Summary

Improves Crow Testing guidance for agreeing on expected behavior and verifying tests across new and existing features.

## Highlights

- Adds Example Mapping guidance to help reviewers agree on rules, examples, and open questions before test implementation.
- Clarifies how Crow Testing supports greenfield work, brownfield characterization, and bug-regression tests.
- Simplifies scenario documentation with a business-readable test matrix and optional detail for complex cases.
- Adds predict-then-verify guidance and a safe hand-off process for tests written before implementation.

## Changes

- Adds readiness signals for deciding when to resolve questions or split an oversized story or rule.
- Defines how unimplemented behavior is represented by skipped tests on a feature branch until implementation is confirmed.
- Clarifies sources for rules: stories, acceptance criteria, and stakeholders for greenfield work; additional code, documentation, and existing tests for brownfield work.
- Preserves the testing agent's boundary against production-code changes while clarifying developer or explicitly authorized implementation hand-offs.

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell

```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.17.3.zip --global --target copilot
```
